//: Type-checking configuration for extension development inside the image.
Extensions need no node_modules at runtime -- Pi's jiti loader aliases
@earendil-works/* and typebox to its own copies -- but tsc still has to be
pointed at those copies. The two wildcard paths cover both the top level of
Pi's install prefix and its nested dependencies.
Copy this file next to your own extension and run `tsc --noEmit`.
